summary: No blocking integrity finding. Full installed-GT selected normal metrics and actual formal update accounting pass; one-seed benchmark selection, paper-recipe scope and small CPU feature-replay rounding differences require qualification.

warning_findings.finding: Epoch17 is the earliest maximum official benchmark mAP among 50 epochs. One seed and historical head8 controls support a qualified selected normal score, not untouched-test generalization, head-count causal improvement, new dual-axis contribution or robustness across seeds/settings.

Saved distances reproduce every selected metric and per-query field exactly. Recomputing all 14,706,125 distances from the saved features is numerically close but not bitwise identical. Float32 changes AP for85 queries and mAP by +0.0000049090001113pp; float64 changes AP for65 queries and INP for1, with mAP -0.0000001748973375pp and mINP +0.0001145213534244pp. First-match ranks and CMC1-50 are unchanged. Every observed ordering inversion is bounded by the measured distance-rounding perturbation. Preserve the original saved-distance metric row; do not relabel feature replay as exact.

Primary DeMo CLIP Table2 reports RGBNT10086.2mAP/97.6Rank1;87.2/98.6 is the requested +1pp target. This candidate85.4449474823/96.9096209913 is below both. Executed training uses batch64, whereas the paper specifies batch128 for RGBNT100; this is a project baseline recipe, not an exact paper training reproduction. Same50epochs alone does not establish a matched update budget with a historical run.

Requested gpt-6-astra/max routing is UNATTESTED by the child host. This fresh review is same-family and provisional. Current selected checkpoint tensors and stored metrics were checked without Torch/model/CUDA; no new weight-forward or optimizer-state replay was performed. Reused native8-query strict reload and recorded final full-Q/G strict reload remain historical execution evidence.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: Directly enumerated installed RGBNT100 JPG filenames in official bounding_box_train/query/bounding_box_test, parsed identity and camera independently, and matched every record against the saved manifest and all NPZ labels/names. Train and test identity sets are disjoint. The scene value is the sentinel -1, not an independently annotated scene.
limitations: Installation origin, official download signature and image pixels were not reauthenticated. The GT check establishes identity with the installed official split, not an end-to-end dataset supply-chain attestation.

B_score_normalization.details: Raw AP and INP are averages of GT-positive retrieval ranks after same-ID/same-camera removal. CMC uses the first remaining GT match. Only multiplication by 100 converts to percentage points; no denominator is a model maximum/minimum/mean. L2 descriptor normalization is part of distance construction and is not score normalization.

C_result_existence_and_numbers.details: All 139 request inputs exist and match their byte counts and SHA-256. Completed training and audit launch/exit records, 50 logged epochs, result/status, selected CSV/JSON, archived checkpoint and NPZ are coherent. Six metrics, CMC50, all 1715 selected per-query rows and all 8 camera/1 sentinel-scene/50 identity groups reproduce exactly from saved distances plus directly installed GT. All 50 epoch per-query tables, CMC50 and groups independently aggregate to epochs.csv. The selected CSV and JSON are byte-identical to epoch 17. No per-metric checkpoint splicing.

D_actual_call_chain.details: The recorded training argv invokes run_vehicle_atmoe_head_baseline.py with --atmoe-heads 32, --variant demo, --seed 42 and --mode train. That entry sets configuration and calls run_full_official_experiment.main; its evaluate calls extract, distance and full_metrics every epoch and after loading the selected checkpoint. Per-epoch/selected output files and the completion log provide actual call evidence. The separate normal CPU audit has an actual exit-0 record and expected completion line. Historical development main functions and the unused all49 main were inspected as source dependencies, not executed or credited as evaluation evidence.
limitations: The audit does not independently forward the selected weights. The exact executed full source tree at training time is not cryptographically attested by this request: it supplies current source seals, launch/log evidence and two explicit deployment-source hashes. Do not promote that to a complete runtime source attestation.

E_scope.details: One RGBNT100 normal-input baseline configuration, seed42, full official eligible training data and full official Q/G; 50 epochs with benchmark-mAP checkpoint selection. No missing-modality results, new module, dual-axis result, matched retrained head8 ablation or multi-seed robustness follows. Historical head8 references are not a contemporaneously retrained control. This is an original DeMo identity baseline, with no teacher50+expert50 dependency or four-state ablation in this run.

F_evaluation_type.details: Installed benchmark identity/camera annotations supply GT; feature-derived similarities provide predictions. The model does not manufacture reference labels. One normal full-Q/G condition, with official-benchmark selection explicitly disclosed.

selected_result.selection: Earliest maximum official benchmark mAP over epochs1..50

training_accounting.limits: Full training means the full8675-record split was eligible and every record participated in successful updates over the run. It does not mean each record appears once in every identity-sampled epoch. Update counts follow the recorded GradScaler transition semantics; optimizer states were not replayed.

all_epoch_verification.limitation: Saved features/distances are available for the selected checkpoint only. The other49 epoch curves were independently aggregated and GT-metadata checked from their actual CSV rows; they were not reconstructed from unavailable raw distances.

checkpoint_tensor_verification.HDM_head_count_evidence: Source GeneralFusion derives512//64; tensor matrices alone do not encode num_heads.
checkpoint_tensor_verification.limitation: Metadata/storage validation only; model construction, Torch deserialization, new forward and new strict reload were not run.

source_and_pretraining.configured_pretraining: Public CLIP ViT-B/16 path in run.json; fresh identity heads by source construction
source_and_pretraining.limits: The pretrained archive hash/download provenance was not reauthenticated in the permitted selected-artifact pass. Current local source seals and launch/log witnesses do not attest all historical runtime source bytes.

runtime_scope.includes: Single recorded final selected extraction of concatenated query+gallery, transforms/loading, model feature forwards and final CUDA synchronization.
runtime_scope.excludes: Distance matrix construction, ranking/metric calculation and output/NPZ/checkpoint serialization occur outside extract timing.
runtime_scope.peak_limitation: No peak-memory reset separates training and final inference; this is the process CUDA peak, not independently isolated inference memory. No new benchmark/cost measurement.
